title: Search multiple locations for required objects
description: Use when a task requires finding multiple instances of the same object type.
content: When collecting multiple identical objects, do not assume they are all in one place. Search different receptacles and surfaces systematically, and revisit locations after picking up an item because the environment may reveal new objects or change state.

title: Retry failed take actions after examining the location
description: Use when a take action fails even though the object appears in the observation.
content: If a take action returns "Nothing happens," examine the location to confirm the object is still present, then retry the take action. The failure may be transient, and a subsequent attempt can succeed.

title: Open a closed container before placing items inside
description: Use when the target container is closed and you need to put objects into it.
content: Before moving an object into a drawer or other closed container, first go to the container and open it. Then move the held object into the open container, and ensure you move the currently held object rather than an object already inside.

title: Locate target objects by systematically examining containers
description: Use when the target object is not visible on surfaces and needs to be found in storage containers.
content: When searching for an object like a soapbar, check drawers and other storage containers by examining them one by one. The object may be hidden inside a drawer alongside other items, so take it from the container once found.

title: Clean objects at a sink basin before placing them
description: Use when a task requires cleaning an object before storing or delivering it.
content: To clean an object, first pick it up, then go to a sink basin and use the clean action with the sink basin. The sink basin does not need to have visible items on it to be usable for cleaning.

title: Open closed cabinets before placing items inside
description: Use when the destination cabinet is closed and you need to put an item into it.
content: Before moving an item into a cabinet, check if the cabinet is closed and open it if necessary. Once the cabinet is open, move the item into it to complete the placement task.
